newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Gold Corp says bullion demand off.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Gold Corp says bullion demand off.

text.p: Gold Corp, Australia's biggest gold refiner, said on Friday that demand for bullion coins was lagging and predicted a shakeout in the industry.

"The outlook for bullion coin demand was not encouraging in an environment in which producers were capping the gold price on the upside by selling forward on any upward movement in the price," Gold Corp said in a statement.
Demand from the gold fabricating sector, however, was underpinning the gold price on the downside, it added.

With expectations of continued low inflation and potential official sector gold bullion sales inhibiting investor confidence, further attrition in the world bullion coin market could be expected, Gold Corp said.

Profits at Gold Corp in 1995/96 (July/June) fell 50 percent to about A$3 million from A$6 million in the previous year due to weakened demand and a significant increase in precious metals lease costs, it said.
Gold Corp is owned by the Western Australia government and operates the Perth Mint.
